paragraphs.text: DSH chat search plugin: global cross-session & in-chat search with context navigation
# dsh-chat-search
English | 简体中文
Chat search and context highlighting plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Supports global cross-sessio
n search across all tasks and precise in-chat keyword searching.
## Security and compatibility

Version 1.0.1 requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or later. Search is registered through
DSH's protected Connect

ion Fetch dispatcher and is restricted to an authenticated
owner. Missing or failing authentication

closes access before session discovery
or reading; there is no public WebServer route fallback. Resp

onses produced by
the plugin use `Cache-Control: no-store`, omit cross-origin permission headers,
an
d return generic errors without internal paths or session text.

The browser client continues to use same-origin requests and the normal DSH
login. After updating, r

eload the host and browser to load the new code. Run
`npm test` for synthetic regression tests; thes
e tests do not use personal chats.
## ✨ Features

- 🌐 **Global Cross-Session Search**:
- Scan all task sessions and history across multiple workspaces

roles (user/assistant), turn indices, and timestamps;
- Click to switch sessions automatically with
smooth scrolling and glow highlight animations.
/next matches with keyboard shortcuts.

- 🎯 **Context Highlighting & Instant Navigation**:
- Multi-tier DOM anchor resolution (`data-chat-an

chor-key` / `data-chat-node-key` / `data-chat-turn`);
- Smooth viewport scrolling + 2.5s pulsing out
line glow (`dsh_cs_flash`) to pinpoint target messages immediately.
Close search panel.

- 🎨 **Native Theme Integration**:
- Built with DSH theme CSS variables, seamlessly matching dark and

light modes;
- Sleek glassmorphism floating action button (🔍) in the bottom-right corner.
